title: Ledup highlights bento
description: A centred label, headline and paragraph over a two-row bento of soft 20px cards: photo cards with a dark bottom scrim and a white label, white product cards with a small centred product shot and a faint grey haze, and one warm orange stat card. Every card has a 60px circle arrow at the bottom-right. Cards rise 40px and fade in as they scroll into view, staggered; product cards lift 6px with a deeper shadow on hover. On phones the cards stack, 160px tall.
notes: each row sets its own column widths with a weight per card (the original: 408/299/190/299 then 299/626/299)

photo-card media fills the card (cover); product media sits in a 100px (phone) / 150px (desktop) square; the stat card's media (a video on the original) fills it, and empty shows a warm highlight-to-glow gradient
photo-card labels are text-background over a foreground scrim: on dark themes the scrim turns pale and the labels dark
CSS only: reveals are scroll-driven, hovers are transitions
